assistworld-assist-world:lever:075465e5-.title: Receptionist & Customer Support Assistant
assistworld-assist-world:lever:075465e5-.description: About the Role A fast-growing, high-end window and door retailer with multiple locations across several US states is looking for a reliable, professional Remote Receptionist & Customer Support Assistant. You will be the first point of contact for all inbound calls, using an existing decision tree and extension list to route callers to the correct location or department. Over time, you may also support light administrative tasks such as basic data entry and updating records in a CRM. This role will be part of a small remote receptionist team to provide broad weekday coverage across US time zones. Key Responsibilities Inbound Call Handling & Call Routing ● Answer all incoming calls in a professional, friendly, and polished manner. ● Use a provided decision tree and extension list to: ○ Identify the caller’s needs. ○ Route calls to the correct location, department, or person. ● Take detailed messages when the appropriate contact is unavailable and ensure timely follow-up. ● Manage periods of higher call volume while maintaining a calm, courteous demeanor. Customer Service & Communication ● Provide basic information to callers based on FAQs, scripts, and reference documents. ● Maintain a high level of customer care in all interactions, representing a premium, high-end brand. ● Escalate complex or unusual issues to designated internal contacts. Administrative & System Support (Light) ● Capture and update caller information and call details into a CRM or project management system (e.g., BuilderTrend or similar). ● Assist with simple spreadsheets and data entry (e.g., logging calls, tracking basic metrics, updating extension lists). ● Flag any recurring issues, common questions, or process gaps to management for continuous improvement. Process & Documentation ● Follow existing call scripts, decision trees and SOPs precisely. ● Suggest improvements to scripts or workflows where appropriate. ● Keep internal documentation (lists, numbers, notes) accurate and up to date. Tools & Systems You should be comfortable with: ● Cloud-based phone/VoIP systems. ● Basic office tools: Google Workspace or Microsoft Office (especially email, calendar, and spreadsheets). ● CRM or customer management platforms (experience with any CRM is helpful). Nice-to-have: ● Experience with BuilderTrend or other construction / home-improvement CRMs. ● Experience handling calls across multiple locations or branches. Ideal Candidate Profile ● 3+ years experience in a receptionist, call center, front desk, or customer service role. ● Excellent spoken English with a clear, easy-to-understand accent. ● Confident and professional phone presence; comfortable answering calls for most of the shift. ● Strong listening skills and ability to quickly understand caller needs and follow structured logic (decision tree). ● High attention to detail when taking messages, logging information, and routing calls. ● Tech-savvy and quick to learn new systems, tools, and processes. ● Reliable, punctual, and comfortable working US business hours. ● Experience working with US-based companies is a plus. Work Schedule ● Coverage Window: Tuesday-Friday 12 noon-8 pm Eastern time Saturday 8-5 Eastern time

campfire-campfire:ashbyhq:9fd5bfbc-9ac6-.title: Sr. Implementation Manager
campfire-campfire:ashbyhq:9fd5bfbc-9ac6-.description: This role is based in San Francisco and requires working in the office five days per week alongside the team. OUR STORY Campfire is a next-gen core accounting platform built for modern mid-market finance teams. We help them close fast and scale even faster. Our platform replaces outdated legacy ERPs and manual accounting processes with automation-driven solutions that simplify and accelerate finance workflows. In the past year alone, we have grown 10x, driven by strong customer demand and a product that delivers real results for accounting & finance teams. We are scaling quickly and building the future of finance by giving teams the clarity, control, and strategic visibility they need to lead with confidence. About the Role We are looking for a Senior Implementation Manager to lead our most complex customer implementations and help strengthen how implementations are delivered across the team. Senior Implementation Managers partner closely with finance leaders and technical teams to deploy the platform across complex accounting environments, ensuring financial workflows, reporting structures, and data migrations are implemented accurately. In addition to leading implementations, this role helps evolve our implementation approach by contributing to playbooks, migration patterns, and internal best practices. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Lead the most complex and high-impact customer implementations from kickoff through go-live - Guide customers through configuring the platform to align with their accounting workflows, financial reporting structures, and operational processes - Oversee complex financial data migrations from ERP, GL, and related financial systems while ensuring data accuracy - Lead testing and validation of financial workflows, reporting outputs, and system configuration - Identify risks or financial/data discrepancies early and drive solutions to keep implementations on track - Serve as a senior point of contact for customers and an escalation resource for Implementation Managers - Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Experience teams to resolve complex workflow or technical challenges - Contribute to improving implementation playbooks, migration approaches, and internal best practices - Ensure a smooth transition to Customer Experience or Support after go-live WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE - Customers successfully launch with core financial workflows and reporting fully operational - Complex financial data migrations reconcile accurately after implementation - Implementations stay on schedule with minimal rework or escalations - Implementation Managers have support when navigating challenging customer situations - Improvements to implementation playbooks and processes that strengthen how the team operates WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - Strong experience leading complex software implementations or financial system deployments - Deep understanding of accounting processes and financial workflows (GL, close, reporting, reconciliations) - Background in accounting, finance, consulting, or financial systems implementation (CPA strongly preferred) - Experience working with ERP or financial systems such as NetSuite, SAP, QuickBooks, Sage, or Oracle - Comfort managing complex data migrations, system configuration, and financial data validation - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with finance stakeholders, technical teams, and customers - Ability to mentor and guide team members while leading complex implementations - Ability to manage multiple complex projects in a fast-paced environment

pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:c1d73167-cb15-43a.title: Founding Forward Deployed Engineer
pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:c1d73167-cb15-43a.description: FOUNDING FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER New York City · In Person · Travel Required ABOUT FRONTDESK Frontdesk is building AI workers that run customer operations across voice, text, email, and chat. Over the last year, the size of the contracts we've been closing has increased roughly 10x, with several enterprise deals now reaching six figures and beyond. At that scale, deployment stops being simple. Our largest customers need custom integrations, complex workflows, outbound orchestration, legacy systems connected, and dozens of edge cases handled before AI can actually run meaningful parts of their business. We're looking for the person who wants to own that problem. THE ROLE We're hiring our Founding Forward Deployed Engineer. You will take our hardest enterprise customers from: "We want Frontdesk to do this" → "It's live in production." There won't always be a playbook. You might fly to a customer's office, sit with their operators, understand a workflow nobody has documented properly, design the solution, and then build the missing integration or product capability yourself. You won't throw requirements over the wall to another team. You'll work directly in the codebase and own the outcome. And once it works, you'll ask the most important question: How do we make sure we never have to build this from scratch again? You'll take what you learn in the field and turn it into reusable Frontdesk product, infrastructure, and deployment primitives. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own our largest and most technically difficult enterprise deployments. - Work directly with customers to understand how their businesses actually operate. - Build integrations, workflows, internal tooling, and product capabilities needed to get them live. - Travel onsite when being in the room helps us solve the problem faster. - Work across voice, SMS, email, chat, APIs, data, LLMs, and workflow orchestration. - Debug whatever is blocking a deployment, even when the problem sits outside Frontdesk. - Identify patterns across customers and turn one-off solutions into scalable product. - Work closely with the founders and engineering team on what Frontdesk should build next. THIS IS A FOUNDING ROLE We expect this to become a major function inside Frontdesk. At first, you'll be extremely hands-on. You'll write code, work with customers, and personally own deployments. As we scale, we expect you to build and eventually lead the Forward Deployed Engineering organization. That means defining how we deploy enterprise AI, hiring the team, building the playbooks, and determining how Forward Deployed Engineering works with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success. We're looking for someone who doesn't just want a job. We're looking for someone who wants to build something from zero, own a massive surface area, and eventually lead the organization they create. YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU - Are a strong software engineer who wants more ownership than a traditional engineering role provides. - Love talking to customers and solving real problems, not just working from tickets. - Are comfortable jumping across the stack and learning whatever is necessary. - Have strong product intuition and naturally think about how to generalize what you build. - Thrive when the problem is ambiguous and there is no existing playbook. - Move extremely quickly and take personal ownership over outcomes. - Would rather own an entire problem than a small piece of a large system. - Could see yourself founding a company someday, or already think like a founder.

Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we want? We seek a skilled supervisor to drive results. This individual will need to be the gold standard in all our processes, so attention to detail and high drive to win is a must. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You will manage a team of highly trained, optimistic Advisors, Operators, and Attendants to provide exceptional guest service in a fun, interactive atmosphere. We need a dedicated team member that has experience in a supervisory role, and a willingness to learn the car wash industry. Location: Speeders Car Wash 3011 NJ-10 Morris Plains, NJ 07950

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:1af55554-dad.title: Non-Linguistic Quality Control Specialists (China)
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:1af55554-dad.description: Welo Life Sciences, a Welo Global brand, is a specialized language and technology partner serving pharmaceutical, CRO, and medical device organizations operating in regulated global markets. We deliver regulator-ready translation, linguistic validation, and localization solutions that support clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, labeling, and global commercialization. We are expanding its non-Linguistic Quality Control (QC) team to support some of the world's leading pharmaceutical and CRO clients, and we're looking for detail-obsessed QC specialists who take real pride in catching what others miss.If you love the precision of quality control and want your work to matter in an industry where accuracy genuinely impacts patient safety, this is your opportunity to join a high-visibility program with steady, daily volume and long-term growth potential. What you'll do Perform Quality Control of translations into English for pharmacovigilance, regulatory, and clinical content. Ideal candidate brings experience with clinical/regulatory documents (medical reports, protocols, synopses, ICF, discharge and study reports, SmPC, PIL, medical literature, linguistic validation) or pharmacovigilance documents (SAE/AE, PSURs, SUSARs, ICSRs, DSUR, RMP) Use CAT tools (XTM preferred) and run QC checks to ensure accuracy and consistency. Validate formatting, numbers, dates, units, terminology, and adherence to instructions. Support processing of non-editable/handwritten sources and perform formatting QC after conversion. Self-assign work according to availability via Open Offers and meet urgent TATs (typically 12–24 hours). Handle high volume split across multiple small files; document and report discrepancies. Cross-collaboration with PMs and escalate risks promptly. Requirements Mandatory experience with CAT tools: XTM, Trados, MemoQ, Phrase or others. Experience with QA checks: Xbench, Verifika, or CAT-integrated QA. Experience with Track Changes function in Word. Minimum 6 months as a Language QA specialist in localization. Advanced English level, min. C1 Availability of 4–5 hours per day; willing to work weekends and bank holidays. Able to meet urgent TATs (12–24 hours) and manage many small files. Willing to complete the QC test and follow staged onboarding. Prior experience with a similar QC role at an LSP is a strong plus. Nice to have Flexibility and willingness to work occasional weekends and bank holidays.
